steps: Install the Pogo app and create a free account at joinpogo.com.
Securely link your bank/credit cards via Plaid (or upload receipts instead).
Shop normally — Pogo auto-tracks qualifying purchases; claim them in the app (purchases within the last 14 days can be claimed).
Decide on Data Dividends opt-in/out in Privacy settings (opting out may limit rewards).
Cash out via PayPal or Venmo once you reach the minimum.
